It includes renewable energy generation (solar, wind, hydro), energy storage (batteries, pumped hydro), and the modernization of the electrical grid (smart meters, transmission lines, grid software). It is distinct from traditional fossil fuel companies and from pure-play EV manufacturers, focusing instead on the supply side of clean energy and the distribution network. Investors are attracted to this theme due to regulatory mandates, falling costs of renewables, and the critical need for grid stability as electrification expands.
